fields.profile: [distanceFromTopM, elevationM, slopeDeg (30 m smoothed)] every 20 m
fields.steepSections: stretches >=15 m long where smoothed slope >=30 deg
fields.pitchBreaks: slope change >=10 deg over 60 m (LiDAR-derived rollovers/benches)
fields.edgeTreeDensity: share of 1 m cells with canopy >2.5 m in bands 3-18 m outside the median open width, both sides
fields.medianOpenWidthM: median canopy-free width across the line (LiDAR)
fields.surfaceObserved: only what was seen in frame grabs (groomed/ungroomed/moguls/gladed); null = not observed
fields.difficultyCorrection: official difficulty when the game currently differs

meta.notes: Observations are from sampled frames only; [inferred] marks interpretation. LiDAR flown Jul 2025 (summer), so widths/canopy reflect summer ground.

observations.note: Colin West 'Juniper & Wild Bill'. Wide groomed open upper slope with orange-padded snowmaking/lift structures (1:46), sparse trees at top, big valley views; mid-section groomed corridor between tall open-trunk pines (2:29); lift tower with yellow pad at trail edge (3:12-3:54) [inferred: passes Quickdraw tower line].
Oviatt. Starts beside Quickdraw top building (0:18); wide groomed convex rollovers (0:56-2:48); terrain-park-like features / snow piles and a yellow structure near the bottom (3:25).

Colin West 'Juniper & Wild Bill'. Wide groomed open upper slope with orange-padded snowmaking/lift structures (1:46), sparse trees at top, big valley views; mid-section groomed corridor between tall open-trunk pines (2:29); lift tower with yellow pad at trail edge (3:12-3:54) [inferred: passes Quickdraw tower line].
Oviatt. Starts beside Quickdraw top building (0:18); wide groomed convex rollovers (0:56-2:48); terrain-park-like features / snow piles and a yellow structure near the bottom (3:25).
R&A chapter. Wide groomed slope with convex rolls and scattered small trees at the top, broad views; lower section narrows and becomes more treed with dense conifer edges.
Similar wide groomed slope.
Oviatt. Groomed, wide, consistent pitch; Quickdraw lift towers and cable visible alongside (0:29-0:48); dense tall conifer walls; ends at base lift loading area with signage and a hut (1:46).
Colin West (shared with Juniper): wide groomed upper slope, mid-section corridor between tall pines, yellow-padded lift tower at the trail edge (3:12-3:54).

R&A chapter overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Chute (black diamond)'. Starts on groomed rolling snow from Quickdraw top past lift-top building; wide open groomed upper section with snow-loaded conifers on one edge; convex rollover with views; open sparse trees at edges near top.

Starts at Quickdraw top station (blue/black direction sign visible at 0:22); wide groomed convex rollovers, sparse subalpine trees near top; mid-section groomed corridor with conifer walls both sides, yellow-topped boundary/marker poles at 3:21; ends at village with condo buildings visible (4:05).

R&A chapter overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Chute (black diamond)'. Starts on groomed rolling snow from Quickdraw top past lift-top building; wide open groomed upper section with snow-loaded conifers on one edge; convex rollover with views; open sparse trees at edges near top.

Starts at Quickdraw top station (blue/black direction sign visible at 0:22); wide groomed convex rollovers, sparse subalpine trees near top; mid-section groomed corridor with conifer walls both sides, yellow-topped boundary/marker poles at 3:21; ends at village with condo buildings visible (4:05).

Romagnoli, Feb 2022 powder day. Ungroomed deep snow, steep; skier falls (0:57-1:36) in deep snow. 2:14 shows open bowl/slope with dense snow-loaded conifers on the left edge and small scattered trees/shrubs in the run; consistent with natural (not cut) treed edges.

Ian Watson, Jan 2016. Upper part open alpine with isolated snow-ghost trees (0:13), wide groomed corduroy, convex rollovers with valley views (0:41-1:37); lower part narrower groomed corridor between dense snow-loaded conifers (2:05-2:33); safety fencing/netting visible at 2:33.
R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Grouse Gulch (black)'. Starts among snow ghosts near the top, narrow corridor with conifer walls (15:45), opens to wide groomed convex slope with views (15:55).
Romagnoli, Feb 2022 powder. Ungroomed, steep, soft bumps/chop under new snow; dense conifer edge on one side (0:25, 2:55); tree islands at 2:55; wide open fall-line slope (3:45-4:35).

R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Hanks (black)'. Starts among snow-ghost trees near the summit ridge; small summit hut/building visible (3:58); wide open convex upper slope with big views and a few isolated trees (4:03-4:08).

R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / K2 (black)'. Starts at a 'Best way down' style green arrow sign near fencing (10:25); narrow ungroomed line through snow-loaded leaning conifers with heavy rime; bumps/chop; dense trees on both edges; opens slightly near bottom (10:58).
rkitt12. Wide open bowl, ungroomed with moguls throughout; scattered small subalpine trees and snow ghosts inside the bowl; dense rimed trees on the skyline edges.

R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / The Pit (black)'. Starts from open summit area with sparse snow-ghost trees (7:22-7:33); ungroomed soft snow through a short tight treed section (7:43-7:54); runs out into a groomed run with skiers and a lift terminal with fence posts (8:05-8:15).

R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Tongue (black)'. Off the Quickdraw top: wide open, lightly treed convex summit slope with scattered snow ghosts (3:10-3:19), trail sign post (3:19), then a narrower line into denser snow-loaded conifers (3:24-3:29).

R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Westbank (black)'. Starts beside Quickdraw lift line (lift towers/cable visible 9:34); ungroomed soft bumps in a corridor ~2-3 skier-widths between dense rimed conifers (9:45-10:06); groomed-looking wider runout at 10:16.

James Rogers, Dec 2012. Starts beside Quickdraw top (chairs overhead, groomed cat track along the lift 0:07); passes big snow ghosts (0:22); open steep slope along the lift line with towers (0:37, 1:23); conifer edges dense and rimed (0:52-1:07).

R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Gromit (double black)'. Steep wide ungroomed open slope with dense conifer walls on both sides (16:51-17:05); tight trees with leaning/thin trunks on the edge (17:12); scattered small trees in the run (17:19); ends at a lodge building with skiers (17:26) [inferred: near base/village lodge].
R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Gunbarrel (double black)'. Narrow ungroomed steep corridor between dense snow-loaded conifers (2:13-2:40), soft bumps/chop; then chair ride.

Charles Vallance 'Gunbarrel Glades'. Deep snow, steep open slopes broken by clumps of tall conifers (glade character), tight trees at the bottom (4:35); on-screen caption about avoiding the trees below.
2012 clip. Ungroomed steep slope with soft moguls; dense snow-loaded conifers right at the edge; corridor ~1 run-width, tree walls both sides.
Romagnoli, Feb 2022 (very low light/blue cast). Deep ungroomed snow, steep open fall line; tree edge visible near top (0:15) and at bottom (2:45). Little terrain detail readable.

R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Mini Colorado (double black)'. Steep open slope dropping off a convex edge with sparse trees on the skier's left and a dense tree wall on the right; ungroomed (16:06-16:26).
R&A overlay 'Quickdraw Chair / Twenty Two (double black)'. Ungroomed deep snow through gladed rimed subalpine trees with openings (6:24-6:51); funnels into a narrow tree-walled chute (6:57).
Romagnoli, Feb 2022. Steep ungroomed; tree islands and tight edges (1:15-2:05); steep open fall line with tree wall on one side (2:55-4:35).

Oviatt. Groomed cat-track-style trail ~2-3 groomer widths wide, tall dense conifer walls both sides; 1:25 shows a cut bank on the uphill side and a trail sign post; 2:13 lift tower visible beside trail (passes under/near Stock's chair); gentle consistent grade.

Oviatt 'Ridge Run and Easy Out'. Upper part (Ridge Run) wide open groomed ridge with scattered single trees and big valley views; convex rollover (1:26) into wider slope; lower part groomed with dense treeline on one side, lift and skiers visible at bottom (3:09).

Oviatt. Groomed corduroy, moderate width, chairlift (Stock's) cable/towers overhead at 0:12-0:36 [inferred: runs beside Stock's chair top]; dense tall conifer edges; mild rollers (1:48, 2:12); wide merge at bottom.
Oviatt. Narrow cat-track width traverse through mature open-trunked forest (0:15); trail sign posts (0:45, 2:16); widens to groomed run near base with lifts and buildings visible (2:45).

Oviatt (on-screen title: 'Green circle, access route for both Stocks/triple and Quickdraw/quad chairs'). Groomed cat-track width, trail sign at start (0:06), fence/marker poles along the edge (0:20), gentle grade along dense treeline, ends at a chair loading station with blue signage and rope lines (1:13).
Oviatt. Groomed, wide gentle traverse; lodges/condos visible at the end (3:13); dense treeline on the uphill side.
Aleksandr Belous, Feb 2021 (title 'Whipsaw - Maverick'). Soft ungroomed powder at the start with conifer edges (0:17-1:27), wide groomed lower section with skiers gathered near a lift area (3:12).
Oviatt. Groomed, wide-ish winding run with tall dense conifer walls; several bends; moderate pitch; big valley views (2:38); steepish side pitch on the lower half (3:13).
